comment_regular: OBLIVION AUTHORITY 2026-08-27: CLeafLodEngine::FindPairs accepts a 16-byte leaf-vector value. For each primary leaf in source order, it scans a contiguous following prefix only until end or the first already-marked candidate, chooses the nearest position within spacing tolerance, and marks only that chosen match. A leaf already used as a match may later be a primary. It never compares textureIndexByte, colorScaleByte, packedColor, or texture record, so pairs may cross leaf textures/layers.
